opening.argument: The video centers on StrongBlock developments: an announced token upgrade, dates to watch, and a proposed conversion of Stronger from an ERC-20 token to a native token when Strong chain launches. It does encourage viewers to prepare through nodes, holdings, or staking, but presents those steps as participation in the upgrade while acknowledging that the snapshot date has not been announced. The speaker also directs viewers to do their own research before putting money into projects. This is promotional financial commentary, but the cited material does not establish a specific deceptive solicitation, a guaranteed return, or concealed diversion of money or data.

citations.quote: The announcement was finally dropped and they did mention some really important dates and developments to be aware of if you're a part of the Strongblock community.
So Stronger is an ERC-20 token, so it was minted on the ETH chain. Now when Strong chain launches, Stronger will convert to a native token
some steps that you can take to get ready is to have a node hold strong a wallet, have strong in the pool or stake it or have an NFT.
Now, no date has been announced for this snapshot
Now nothing I say in this video is financial advice, so please make sure to do your own research before putting your money into any projects.
